Hi Jasmine — tagging in details from infra that are relevant. Short answers up front: yes, we can produce a per-tenant deletion manifest and snapshot identifiers; backup retention windows may require a short retention note.

Details:
- Deletion manifest: We can generate a CSV with object keys and deletion timestamps from the object index and audit logs. That will include logical object ids and the model-kv entries (if applicable). We will include the storage path and the hex snapshot ids for block-level snapshots.

- Snapshots/backups: For demo VPCs we take scheduled snapshots for a 7-day rolling window. Snapshots are retained for 7 days in the same EU region (eu-west-1). There are no cross-region copies for demo tenants by default. After a tenant erase request we mark snapshots for deletion; actual snapshot garbage collection runs in the next retention job (typically within 24–48 hours). For Cerulean's tenant which had a termination request on 2027-03-29, snapshot tombstones were created on 2027-04-01 and GC completed on 2027-04-02 for the snapshots that matched the tenant's volume ids.

- KMS behavior: Keys used for envelope encryption are customer-data-key per-tenant but master key material is managed by Redwood KMS integration. For Private/VPC installs we support two models: customer-managed keys (BYOK) and Redwood-managed keys. For ceru-demo-84 they used Redwood-managed tenant keys. Standard procedure is to retire the tenant-specific data key and schedule it for deletion after a 30-day grace period to allow for any emergency restore requests. The underlying envelope key is rotated; master KMS keys are not deleted. If Cerulean requires immediate destruction of cryptographic material we can escalate to legal and engineering for an exception but that will remove the ability to restore backups that were encrypted with that key.

Artifacts we can deliver by EOD 2027-04-14 (planned):
- cerulean_erase_manifest_20270414.csv (object key, path, deletion timestamp)
- list of snapshot ids and GC timestamps (included in the CSV)
- short attestation draft (internal) for Legal to sign off

Open items for Monica/Legal:
- Monica, confirm whether the 30-day key-retention policy is acceptable or whether Cerulean will ask for an exception for immediate key destruction. If they need immediate key deletion, we should capture a signed waiver due to irreversible loss.

I'll attach the manifest and snapshot summary once the export finishes (ETA today).

— Karthik
